scenarioDefinitions.recipe-baselines-safe: Engine choices + all measured recipe baselines + authored source only when it names no engines. Every nested named engine and chosen root engine must be retained.
scenarioDefinitions.recipes-and-authored-safe: Also allows exact current authored source if all its named engine dependencies are retained. This is a theoretical implementation-availability oracle, not a deployed selector.
scenarioDefinitions.current-ui-fallback: Current authored source and recipes remain available despite hidden engine dependencies; this supports UI hiding only, never implementation deletion.

modeDefinitions.defaults: RIGHT/DOWN default engine configurations plus measured documented-default/current/recipe anchors
modeDefinitions.selected-presets: one selected global RIGHT preset per engine plus measured documented-default/current/recipe anchors
modeDefinitions.combined: default RIGHT/DOWN and selected global RIGHT presets for each retained engine, plus measured anchors; theoretical configuration oracle

sourceFacts: compile.ts engineArrangement filters layouts with explicit engine declarations; built-in row/column/flow/lanes/sequence/cells recipes do not automatically invoke a named LayoutLab engine.
Nested explicit engine declarations survive sourceFor root replacement and recipe baselines. Dependency-safe availability requires those engine IDs too.

This is outcome-preservation evidence, not a code-deletion build or source-migration test. Shared library dependencies, exported IDs, stored documents, warm actions, and compatibility must be addressed before implementation deletion.

minimumConfigurationPolicy.nativeRecipeAvailability: All six structural recipes, implicit baseline, and authored current source whose engine dependencies are retained; this is separate from the counted global configurations.
minimumConfigurationPolicy.objective: Smallest configuration count meeting relative95% separately under all common profiles with no new current-valid hard case; ties maximize accepted jobs then valid jobs. Engine set was chosen first; this is not joint exhaustive optimization over every engine/configuration set.
